about: Vecima Networks Inc. engages in the development of integrated hardware and software solutions for broadband access and content delivery in the United States, Canada, Japan, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Video and Broadband Solutions, and Content Delivery and Storage. The Video and Broadband Solutions segment provides platforms that process data from the cable network and deliver high-speed Internet connectivity to homes over cable and fiber, as well as adapt video services to formats suitable to be consumed on televisions in commercial properties. Its Entra Broadband Access products include Entra Cloud, an open interoperable set of software applications to centralize orchestration, management, control, and virtualized data plane; and Entra Access Controller that virtualizes all the control components, allowing for the distribution of the data processing to the edge and into the Entra Cable and Entra Fiber nodes. The Content Delivery and Storage segment offers solutions and software under the MediaScale brand for service providers and content owners that focus on ingesting, producing, storing, delivering, and streaming video for live linear, VOD, network digital video recorder, and time-shifted services over the Internet. The company also offers lifecycle program management; installation and commission; training and certification; workforce optimization; and operations and customer support services. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Victoria, Canada. Vecima Networks Inc. operates as a subsidiary of 684739 B.C. Ltd.
